history.sg_progress: The Administration has looked into establishing a cost-tracing regime and, as it has previously informed the Board, there are practical limitations. The best practice is for service providers to do it at the fund-centre level, but, in some cases, it can only be done at the functional-area level. The Administration has released a dashboard to service providers for the use of data models associated with cost recovery. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
